title: Desk Organizer with Pen Holder for Office Supplies
desc: A desk organizer with a pen holder that clears the clutter. Pens, clips and small supplies stay in one reachable spot. Keep the home office desk tidy and productive.

title: 4 Tier Paper Tray File Organizer for Home Office
desc: A 4 tier paper tray that files A4 documents by level. Stack it tall to free the desk surface and keep files upright and easy to find. A tidy file organizer for any home office.

title: Under Desk Cable Tray 25 Inch for Hidden Wires
desc: A 25 inch under desk cable tray that hides wires along the whole length of the desk. Route and cord management in one long run for a clean work from home setup.

title: Bathroom Counter Organizer for Vanity Storage
desc: A bathroom counter organizer that keeps toiletries in one spot. Clears the vanity top and puts bottles, jars and skincare within reach. A clean upgrade for a cluttered bathroom.

title: Over Toilet Storage Rack Space Saver for Small Bathroom
desc: An over toilet storage rack that adds shelves without taking floor space. Keep towels and bathroom essentials neat and within reach. Ideal space saver for a small bathroom.
